parts.name: Spout
parts.Basic_description: The spout is the curved upper part of the faucet made of stainless steel, responsible for directing the flow of water.
parts.Functional_description: It channels water from the internal plumbing to the sink, ensuring smooth and directed flow.
parts.Movement_description: It may swivel horizontally in some designs but generally remains fixed vertically.

parts.name: Switch
parts.Basic_description: The switch is a small plastic lever or knob used to control water flow and temperature.
parts.Functional_description: It allows the user to turn the water on or off and adjust the temperature or pressure.
parts.Movement_description: It rotates or tilts to regulate the internal valve mechanism.

parts.name: Frame
parts.Basic_description: The frame is the cylindrical base of the faucet made of stainless steel, providing structural support.
parts.Functional_description: It houses the internal plumbing and connects the faucet to the sink or countertop.
parts.Movement_description: It remains stationary and serves as the mounting and support structure for the faucet.
